_comment: PixelLab placeholders generated for this project. Schema: docs/authoring/ai_art.md §3. tests/test_assets.tscn requires an entry for every png/wav/ogg in this folder.

entries.method: create_1_direction_object(view=sidescroller, size=128, palette=18 colours) review pack of 4; frame used as-is
entries.prompt: pixel art side-view free-standing mound of fallen rubble rocks and boulders, peak on the left third, rocks tumbling down a long slope to the right, entire pile fully inside the frame with a jagged natural outline on every side, no flat or cut edges, dark grey-brown rock with dusty tan highlights on top edges, transparent background, no text, no ground plane
entries.notes: Sprite2D under crevasse DecorBack (rubble against the crevasse walls). Placeholder decor, no manifest entry. Replaces a first pass (review pack 02fe9a19-…, prompt 'heaped against a cliff wall') whose piles had flat, cut edges.
